items.distractor_fact: 이웃 마을 관측소는 같은 날 기온이 {D}도였다고 발표했다.
items.gloss_en: The observatory in the neighboring village announced that the temperature was {D} degrees that same day.
items.entity_note: different place — a separate observatory in another village, not the story's location

items.gloss_en: A different stock's price closed at {D} won that day.
items.entity_note: different entity — another stock, not the one the question is about

items.gloss_en: The nearby reservoir's water level was {D} cm at the same time.
items.entity_note: different place — a separate, nearby reservoir

items.gloss_en: In a different account, this month's withdrawal amount was {D} won.
items.entity_note: different entity — a separate bank account

items.distractor_fact: 다른 지점의 금고에는 오늘 {D}원이 새로 들어왔다.
items.gloss_en: At a different branch's cash box, {D} won was newly put in today.
items.entity_note: different entity — another branch's cash box

items.gloss_en: The roommate spent {D} won this month.
items.entity_note: different entity — a different person (the roommate), not the story's subject

items.gloss_en: A different freelancer's expenses this month were {D} won.
A different team's goals conceded this season are {D}.
items.entity_note: different entity — a different team with its own separate goal tally

items.distractor_fact: 다른 투자자는 이번 분기에 손실 {D}원을 기록했다.
items.gloss_en: A different investor recorded a loss of {D} won this quarter.

items.gloss_en: A different player shot {D} strokes yesterday on a different course.
